questions.domain: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry
questions.question:
You need to transform written customer notifications into natural-sounding spoken audio for playback through a phone system.  
  
Which Azure Speech in Foundry Tools capability should you use?
questions.explanation:
Speech synthesis, also called text to speech, converts written text into human-like synthesized spoken audio, including for application and phone-system playback.\
\
**Learn more:** [Text to speech overview - Speech service - Foundry Tools](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/Speech-Service/text-to-speech)

questions.domain: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project containing a vision-enabled model deployment.  
  
You use the Azure OpenAI Responses API to send a prompt to the model. You need to supply an image for analysis.  
  
Which content item should be included in the request?
questions.explanation:
For a vision-enabled model, the Azure OpenAI Responses API uses an `input_image` content item to provide an image for analysis. Its `image_url` field can contain either an image URL or a Base64-encoded image as a data URL.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use the Azure OpenAI Responses API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/openai/how-to/responses) · [Microsoft Foundry REST Reference – Azure OpenAI Responses](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/microsoft-foundry/azureopenai/responses)

questions.question:
You are building an application that analyzes voicemail recordings by using Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools.  
  
You need to extract a transcript and structured data from the recordings.  
  
Which analyzer type should you use?
questions.explanation:
Audio analyzers in Azure Content Understanding transcribe conversational audio and extract structured fields from audio files, making them suitable for voicemail recordings.\
\
**Learn more:** [Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools audio overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-understanding/audio/overview)

What are two purposes of instructions when you prompt a generative AI model? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: defines the agent’s role and behavior
defines the Azure region where inference occurs
defines the tokens per minute (TPM) allocation for the model
defines constraints on the model’s responses

questions.explanation:
Prompt instructions provide persistent guidance for an assistant’s role, behavior, and boundaries, and they can specify constraints that control or limit its responses. Model choice, Azure inference region, and tokens-per-minute allocation are configured outside the prompt.

**Learn more:** [System message design for Azure OpenAI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/openai/concepts/advanced-prompt-engineering?view=foundry-classic) · [Write effective prompts for agents in Microsoft Discovery](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/microsoft-discovery/how-to-prompt-engineering)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project with a generative AI model deployment.  
  
You need to ensure that responses generated by the model minimize costs and stay within a defined length.  
  
Which parameter should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Max Completion Tokens sets an upper bound on the tokens generated for a completion, including visible output and reasoning tokens. Limiting generated tokens constrains response length and helps control token-based generation costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Azure OpenAI in Microsoft Foundry Models REST API reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/openai/reference)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project with a generative AI model deployment.  
  
You need to ensure that responses generated by the model minimize costs and stay within a defined length.  
  
Which parameter should you configure?

options.text: a system message that includes both a text item and an image item in the content array
a system message that includes only a text item and sends an image item in a separate request
a user message that includes only a text item and sends an image item in a separate request
a user message that includes both a text item and an image item in the content array

questions.explanation:
A vision-enabled chat request can place text and an image URL together as typed content items in a user message’s content array. Combining them in one request avoids the additional round trip required when the image is sent separately, minimizing response time. System messages provide model instructions; the text-and-image input belongs in the user message.

**Learn more:** [Use image and audio in chat completions with Microsoft Foundry models](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-pt/azure/ai-foundry/foundry-models/how-to/use-chat-multi-modal?view=foundry-classic)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that includes a generative AI model deployment.  
  
You test the model by using the Foundry playground.  
  
You need to build an application that submits requests to the deployed model.  
  
Which information must the application include to call the model?

options.text: The model endpoint and authentication credentials

questions.explanation:
An application calls a deployed model by sending an authenticated inference request to the deployment’s endpoint. Authentication credentials authorize that request; playground history, the training data, and the project display name do not provide the required invocation target and authorization.\
\
**Learn more:** [Azure AI Foundry Models inference API reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-foundry/model-inference/reference/reference)

Speech to text batch transcription is intended for large volumes of audio data held in storage. It can process multiple files or an Azure Blob Storage container, making it suitable for thousands of previously recorded calls.

**Learn more:** [Batch transcription overview - Speech service - Foundry Tools](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/batch-transcription) · [Locate audio files for batch transcription - Speech service - Foundry Tools](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/batch-transcription-audio-data)

questions.domain: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry
questions.question:
You need to create an AI agent in Microsoft Foundry that adheres to a specific role and behavior when responding to users.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
System instructions define an AI agent’s goals, constraints, role, and expected behavior. Temperature controls output randomness, tokens per minute is a capacity limit, and maximum completion tokens controls the maximum response length. Microsoft Foundry identifies instructions as the component that defines an agent’s goals, constraints, and behavior.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is Microsoft Foundry Agent Service?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/overview)

questions.question:
You need to compare the costs of large language models (LLMs) for a generative AI solution.  
  
What should you use in the Microsoft Foundry portal?
questions.explanation:
The Model leaderboard compares models by estimated cost, along with quality, safety, and throughput. It supports cost benchmarking and side-by-side comparison of LLMs for model selection.\
\
**Learn more:** [Compare models using the model leaderboard — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/how-to/benchmark-model-in-catalog) · [Model benchmarks and leaderboards in Microsoft Foundry — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/concepts/model-benchmarks)

questions.domain: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry
questions.question:
You have an Azure subscription.  
  
You need to use Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools to extract structured information from invoices.  
  
What should you provision?
questions.explanation:
Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools is available through a Microsoft Foundry resource and can extract schema-defined structured data from documents such as invoices.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a Microsoft Foundry resource](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-understanding/how-to/create-multi-service-resource) · [What is Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-understanding/overview)

questions.domain: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that includes a vision-enabled chat model deployment.  
  
You are developing a Python application that sends a request with a user prompt and a local JPEG image.  
  
You need to include the image as binary data in the request. What should the `image_url.ur1` field be set to?
questions.explanation:
A local JPEG must be encoded as Base64 and supplied as a data URL using the `data:image/jpeg;base64,` prefix. This embeds the image data directly in the request payload; local file paths are not service-accessible URLs.\
\
**Learn more:** [How to use vision-enabled chat models - Microsoft Foundry](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/openai/how-to/gpt-with-vision)

You are developing a Python application that sends a request with a user prompt and a local JPEG image.  
  
You need to include the image as binary data in the request. What should the `image_url.ur1` field be set to?

questions.domain: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that includes an agent named Agent1.  
  
You need to ensure that Agent1 always invokes an Azure function when it responds to user input.  
  
What should you set `tool_choice` to for Agent1?
questions.explanation:
Setting `tool_choice` to `required` requires the model to call one or more configured tools. `auto` permits the model to answer without a tool call, and `none` prevents tool calls. [Microsoft Foundry Agent Service tool best practices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/concepts/tool-best-practice)\
\
**Learn more:** [Tool best practices for Microsoft Foundry Agent Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry/agents/concepts/tool-best-practice)

questions.question:
You are building an application that processes voicemail recordings by using Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools.  
  
Which Azure Content Understanding feature converts audio into text?
questions.explanation:
Azure Content Understanding audio analyzers use transcription to convert conversational audio into searchable, analyzable text-based transcripts. Key phrase extraction analyzes existing text, OCR extracts text from visual content, and Voice Live is not the audio-to-text conversion feature.\
\
**Learn more:** [Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools audio solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-understanding/audio/overview)

questions.domain: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry
questions.question:
You need to create an AI solution that produces marketing email drafts from a brief description of a product and its intended audience.  
  
Which AI workload should you use?
questions.explanation: Generative AI creates new content, including tailored marketing-email text, from prompts that describe a product and its target audience.

questions.question:
You are building an AI-powered customer support application.  
  
Which task exemplifies the Microsoft responsible AI principle of inclusiveness?

options.text: Encrypt stored customer data and restrict access by using role-based controls.
Evaluate model outputs across demographic groups to reduce bias.
Design the interface to support multiple languages and screen readers.
Provide explanations about how predictions are generated.

questions.explanation: Inclusiveness requires designing systems that can be accessed and used by people with diverse languages, abilities, and needs. Supporting multiple languages and screen readers makes the interface more accessible to a broader range of users.

options.text: an optical character recognition (OCR)-only document processing pipeline
a transcription workflow in Azure Speech in Foundry Tools
an analyzer in Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools

questions.explanation:
An analyzer in Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools defines a field schema for extracting structured document data. Its schema supports nested object and array fields, which accommodates invoice details such as line items and their associated values.

**Learn more:** [What is a Content Understanding analyzer?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-understanding/concepts/analyzer-reference) · [Azure Content Understanding overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-understanding/overview)

questions.question:
A company processes customer-support emails.  
  
An AI solution must automatically recognize mentions of people, organizations, and locations in those emails. Which text-analysis technique should be used?
questions.explanation:
Named Entity Recognition (NER) detects named entities in unstructured text and categorizes them into types such as person, organization, and location.\
\
**Learn more:** [What is named entity recognition (NER) in Azure Language?](https://learn.microsoft.com/mt-mt/azure/ai-services/language-service/named-entity-recognition/overview?tabs=version-3)

questions.domain: Implement AI solutions by using Microsoft Foundry
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft Foundry project that includes a vision-enabled model deployment.  
  
You are developing an application that sends images to the model. You need to ensure the model can analyze those images.  
  
In which two formats can you supply the images? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: a JSON document that describes the image content
a UTF-8 encoded text description of the image
a publicly accessible URL of the image

questions.explanation:
Vision-enabled model inputs support an image reference using a publicly accessible URL and an embedded Base64-encoded image data string. These formats provide the actual image resource or image bytes needed for visual analysis.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use vision-enabled chat models - Microsoft Foundry](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-foundry/openai/how-to/gpt-with-vision)

questions.question:
You need to build an AI solution that creates new product images from written descriptions supplied by users.  
  
Which AI workload should you use?
questions.explanation: Image generation workloads create new images from textual prompts or descriptions. Image analysis interprets existing images, object detection identifies objects within them, and OCR extracts text from images.

You are building an application that extracts fields from PDFs by using Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools.  
  
You need to use the Python SDK to submit a PDF for analysis and retrieve the extraction results.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Call analyze() to return the extracted fields synchronously in the same request.
Submit the PDF to an analyzer and read the results from the request headers.
Call begin_analyze(), and then call poller.result() to retrieve the results.
Use optical character recognition (OCR) to extract text from the PDF and map the fields in the code.

questions.explanation:
Azure Content Understanding analysis uses a long-running operation. The Python SDK's `begin_analyze()` starts analysis and returns a poller, and `poller.result()` waits for the operation to finish and returns the structured `AnalysisResult` containing extracted fields.

**Learn more:** [Azure AI Content Understanding client library for Python](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/overview/azure/ai-contentunderstanding-readme?view=azure-python) · [ContentUnderstandingClient class](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/azure-ai-contentunderstanding/azure.ai.contentunderstanding.contentunderstandingclient?view=azure-python)
